description: This file contains performance testing code for UDP socket write operations, including setup, execution, and benchmarking functions, as well as test cases for blocking and non-blocking socket writes.

classes.name: UDPSocketPerfTest
classes.description: Performance test class for UDP socket write benchmarking, including setup, write operations, and test cases for blocking and non-blocking modes.

methods.name: WritePacketsToSocket
methods.description: Sends a specified number of packets through the UDP socket, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: WriteBenchmark
methods.description: Performs the UDP socket write benchmark, measuring elapsed time and write speed, and reports results.

methods.name: DoneWritePacketsToSocket
methods.description: Callback invoked after each write operation to continue sending packets.
